metadata.description: Self-contained adversarial goal loop for omp: an independent reviewer re-prompts the agent until the goal is met

plugins.name: advisor-consensus
plugins.description: Runs its own reviewer turn after every agent turn and re-prompts the main session while the goal is unmet. Adds /adversarial (on / off / pause / resume / review) and a per-prompt ledger. No advisor dependency and no escalation path.
